title: Amazing Spider-Comics
intro: [excited] Welcome to Disney Jeopardy, true believers! Tonight we leave the movie theater and dig into the long boxes. Sixty-plus years of web-slinging comics, all on one board. [chuckles] Handle with care, these are mint condition.

art.prompt: A cozy comic shop at night with long white boxes, spinner racks and a web pattern of shadows across the floor from the window, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Origin Story
categories.intro: We start at the beginning, the classic comic version. [warmly] A spider, a lesson, a legend.

art.prompt: A small 1960s science exhibit hall with a glowing tank and a curious crowd of shadows, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Spider-Man was co-created by Stan Lee and this artist.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Steve Ditko! He also co-created Doctor Strange.

clues.clue: Peter's first great love, she died in a famous 1973 storyline.
clues.reveal: [softly] The correct answer is Gwen Stacy. A turning point for comics.

clues.clue: Before fighting crime, the newly powered Peter tried to earn cash in this sport.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is wrestling! [laughs] The masked marvel of the ring.

clues.clue: In the classic comics, Peter attends this Queens high school.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Midtown High! Science club captain, naturally.

clues.clue: Peter later studies at this fictional New York college.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Empire State University! [chuckles] Go, ESU!

categories.title: Rogues Gallery
categories.intro: Spidey has one of the best villain lineups around. [dramatically] Let's meet them.

art.prompt: A dark police lineup wall with six empty spotlights and shadowy height marks, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This team of half a dozen Spidey villains first assembled to defeat him in 1964.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Sinister Six! Six against one. Spidey still won.

clues.clue: Dr. Curt Connors regrows his missing arm but becomes this reptilian villain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Lizard! [chuckles] Science has side effects.

clues.clue: Mac Gargan wears a mechanical tail as this villain.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Scorpion! Jonah Jameson paid for that suit, by the way.

clues.clue: In this 1987 storyline, Kraven buries Spider-Man alive and takes his place.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is Kraven's Last Hunt! Dark, moody and a fan favorite.

clues.clue: Spider-Man brought home the black costume that became Venom from this 1984 crossover event.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Secret Wars! [chuckles] Worst souvenir ever.

categories.title: Spider Family
categories.intro: Plenty of heroes have worn the spider. [excited] Name these members of the web-family.

art.prompt: A family photo wall of empty picture frames shaped like spider webs, warm lamplight, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Miles Morales first appeared in the comics in this year.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is 2011! Created by Brian Michael Bendis and Sara Pichelli.

clues.clue: In 2014, an alternate-world Gwen Stacy who got the spider-bite debuted under this nickname.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spider-Gwen! [excited] Later known as Ghost-Spider.

clues.clue: Cindy Moon, bitten by the same spider as Peter, fights crime as this hero.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Silk! She spent years locked in a bunker. Long story.

clues.clue: Ben Reilly, Peter's clone, first wore a hoodie as this hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Scarlet Spider! [chuckles] Blue hoodie, big controversy.

clues.clue: Mayday Parker, daughter of Peter and MJ in an alternate future, fights as this hero.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Spider-Girl! She ran for over a hundred issues.

categories.title: Spider Suits
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a famous spider costume or gadget. Name what I'm asking for.

art.prompt: A secret closet lined with mannequins draped in sheets, one glowing pair of eyes in the dark, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Peter's 1980s black costume turned out to be this.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is an alien symbiote! It came home with Peter and wanted to stay.

media.prompt: A sleek black full-body costume with a large white spider emblem on the chest, hanging in a dim closet, slightly oozing, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Tony Stark-designed armor with extra mechanical legs is called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Iron Spider! [excited] Four extra legs, zero extra rent.

media.prompt: A red and gold armored bodysuit on a display stand with four golden mechanical spider legs extending from its back, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This rebel spider-hero plays guitar and wears spikes. Name him.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Spider-Punk! Hobie Brown, anti-everything.

media.prompt: A patched denim jacket with metal spikes and safety pins next to a battered electric guitar, punk rock club stage, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This 1930s spider-hero sees the world in black and white. Name him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spider-Man Noir! [dramatically] Grim, gritty and very fond of rain.

media.prompt: A black and white rainy 1930s alley with a trench coat, a fedora and round goggles hanging from a fire escape, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Peni Parker pilots this spider-mech. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is SP//dr! Big robot, small pilot, huge heart.

media.prompt: A cute pastel-colored giant robot with spider-like legs standing in a neon futuristic city street, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Bugle Back Issues
categories.intro: Our fan category: famous moments from the comic archives. [whispers] Extra! Extra!

art.prompt: A messy newspaper office desk covered in old photos, a typewriter and a cold cup of coffee, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Peter sells his photos to this New York newspaper.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Daily Bugle! Jonah never paid enough.

clues.clue: Mary Jane Watson's famous first words to Peter end with 'you just hit the' this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is jackpot! [warmly] Face it, Tiger. A classic introduction.

clues.clue: Ben Reilly's 1990s return kicked off this long and divisive storyline.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is the Clone Saga! Fans are still arguing.

clues.clue: In 2007's One More Day, Peter and MJ's marriage is erased by a deal with this demon.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is Mephisto! Never make deals with a guy in red tights.

clues.clue: In The Superior Spider-Man, this villain swaps minds with Peter and takes his life over.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doctor Octopus! [dramatically] He thought he could do it better.
